hypotheses.P0_suffix_router_stays_near_the_subset_o: For every rank, chart count, layer, and corpus, median routed fidelity is within 0.03 of the corresponding finite subset oracle.
hypotheses.P1_two_rotation_atlas_captures_most_of_t: At rank 256, the median two-rotation subset captures at least 80% of the seven-rotation gain over native in every cell.
hypotheses.P2_seven_charts_halve_the_coordinate_bud: At rank 128, native plus seven rotations is within 0.02 of native-only rank 256 in every cell.
hypotheses.P3_seven_charts_quarter_the_coordinate_b: At rank 64, native plus seven rotations is within 0.02 of native-only rank 256 in every cell.
hypotheses.P4_returns_diminish_after_four_rotations: At rank 256, the seven-rotation gain over the median four-rotation subset is at most 0.02 in every cell.
hypotheses.P5_chart_subset_choice_is_robust: At rank 256, the max-minus-min fidelity across all two- and four-rotation subsets is at most 0.05 in every cell.
hypotheses.P6_adaptive_chart_gain_increases_with_de: At rank 128, the seven-rotation gain over native is at least 0.03 larger in Layer 1 than Layer 0 on both corpora.
hypotheses.P7_chart_gain_transfers_ood: For every layer and rank, the seven-rotation gain over native differs by at most 0.10 between FineWeb and TinyStories.
hypotheses.P8_router_never_needs_endpoint_outcomes: All chart choices use midpoint suffix-Fisher predictions only; finite effects are read exclusively after choices are frozen.
